+class PinnedHaloBuffers {
+public:
+    explicit PinnedHaloBuffers(const size_t plane_elements) {
+        const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+    }
+
+    ~PinnedHaloBuffers() {
+        if (send_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_lower_);
+        if (send_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_upper_);
+        if (receive_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_lower_);
+        if (receive_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_upper_);
+    }
+
+    PinnedHaloBuffers(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+    PinnedHaloBuffers& operator=(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+
+    double* sendLower() const noexcept { return send_lower_; }
+    double* sendUpper() const noexcept { return send_upper_; }
+    double* receiveLower() const noexcept { return receive_lower_; }
+    double* receiveUpper() const noexcept { return receive_upper_; }
+
+private:
+    double* send_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* send_upper_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_upper_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+void exchangeHalos(double* const field, const size_t plane_elements,
+                   const size_t local_nz, const int rank, const int ranks,
+                   const int tag, const MPI_Comm communicator,
+                   PinnedHaloBuffers& halos, const cudaStream_t stream) {
+    const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+    const bool has_lower_neighbor = rank > 0;
+    const bool has_upper_neighbor = rank + 1 < ranks;
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendLower(), field + plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendUpper(),
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_lower_neighbor || has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    }
+
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+    int request_count = 0;
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (request_count != 0) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+    }
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, halos.receiveLower(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   halos.receiveUpper(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
 }

+// Initialize only the owned portion of a slab.  The global linear index is
+// retained so MPI decomposition produces exactly the same initial field as
+// the original single-process implementation.
+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                             const size_t local_nz, const size_t z_start,
+                             const size_t global_nz) {
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const size_t volume = plane * global_nz;
+
+    #pragma omp parallel for collapse(3) schedule(static)
+    for (std::ptrdiff_t z = 0; z < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(local_nz); ++z) {
+        for (std::ptrdiff_t y = 0; y < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(ny); ++y) {
+            for (std::ptrdiff_t x = 0; x < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(nx); ++x) {
+                const size_t local_index = idx3(static_cast<size_t>(x),
+                                                static_cast<size_t>(y),
+                                                static_cast<size_t>(z), nx, ny);
+                const size_t global_index =
+                    (z_start + static_cast<size_t>(z)) * plane +
+                    static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+                const double pseudo =
+                    ((((global_index + 1) * 1299709) % volume) /
+                     static_cast<double>(volume));
+                concentration[local_index] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
             }
         }
     }
 }

    18	// The global array is split into contiguous slabs in Z.  Each slab has one
    19	// ghost plane on either side, so both stencil applications are local after
    20	// the two neighboring planes have been exchanged.
    21	__host__ __device__ inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y,
    22	                                                 const size_t z, const size_t nx,
    23	                                                 const size_t ny) noexcept {
    24	    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
    25	}
    26	
    27	struct Slab {
    28	    size_t z_start;
    29	    size_t nz;
    30	};
    31	
    32	Slab slabForRank(const size_t global_nz, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
    33	    const size_t base = global_nz / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
    34	    const size_t remainder = global_nz % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
    35	    const size_t rank_as_size = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
    36	    return {
    37	        rank_as_size * base + std::min(rank_as_size, remainder),
    38	        base + (rank_as_size < remainder ? 1 : 0)
    39	    };
    40	}

    42	[[noreturn]] void mpiFailure(const int error, const char* expression,
    43	                             const char* file, const int line) {
    44	    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
    45	    int message_length = 0;
    46	    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &message_length);
    47	    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI error at %s:%d (%s): %.*s\n",
    48	                 file, line, expression, message_length, message);
    49	    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
    50	    std::abort();
    51	}

    54	    do { \

    56	        if (mpi_error__ != MPI_SUCCESS) { \
    57	            mpiFailure(mpi_error__, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__); \

    77	__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceLaplacian(
    78	    const double* __restrict__ field,
    79	    const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z,
    80	    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
    81	    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2) {
    82	    const size_t xp = (x + 1 < nx) ? x + 1 : x;
    83	    const size_t yp = (y + 1 < ny) ? y + 1 : y;
    84	    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;
    85	    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;
    86	
    87	    const size_t center = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
    88	    const double center_value = field[center];
    89	    const double cxx = (field[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] +
    90	                        field[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] -
    91	                        2.0 * center_value) * inv_dx2;
    92	    const double cyy = (field[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] +
    93	                        field[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] -
    94	                        2.0 * center_value) * inv_dy2;
    95	    const double czz = (field[idx3(x, y, z + 1, nx, ny)] +
    96	                        field[idx3(x, y, z - 1, nx, ny)] -
    97	                        2.0 * center_value) * inv_dz2;
    98	    return cxx + cyy + czz;
    99	}
   100	
   101	__global__ void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(
   102	    const double* __restrict__ concentration,
   103	    double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
   104	    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
   105	    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
   106	    const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {
   107	    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   108	    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   109	    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
   110	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
   111	        return;
   112	    }
   113	
   114	    // z=0 and z=local_nz+1 are the MPI ghost planes.
   115	    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
   116	    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
   117	    const double cv = concentration[index];
   118	    chemical_potential[index] =
   119	        4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) +
   120	        3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv -
   121	        gamma * deviceLaplacian(concentration, x, y, z, nx, ny,
   122	                                inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);
   123	}
   124	
   125	__global__ void cahnHilliardUpdateKernel(
   126	    double* __restrict__ concentration_new,
   127	    const double* __restrict__ concentration_old,
   128	    const double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
   129	    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
   130	    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
   131	    const double D, const double dt) {
   132	    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   133	    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   134	    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
   135	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
   136	        return;
   137	    }
   138	
   139	    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
   140	    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
   141	    concentration_new[index] = concentration_old[index] + dt * D *
   142	        deviceLaplacian(chemical_potential, x, y, z, nx, ny,
   143	                        inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);
   144	}

   146	class DeviceAllocation {
   147	public:
   148	    explicit DeviceAllocation(const size_t elements) {
   149	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), elements * sizeof(double)));
   150	    }
   151	
   152	    ~DeviceAllocation() {
   153	        if (data_ != nullptr) {
   154	            cudaFree(data_);
   155	        }
   156	    }
   157	
   158	    DeviceAllocation(const DeviceAllocation&) = delete;
   159	    DeviceAllocation& operator=(const DeviceAllocation&) = delete;
   160	
   161	    double* data() const noexcept { return data_; }
   162	
   163	private:
   164	    double* data_ = nullptr;
   165	};
   166	
   167	class PinnedHaloBuffers {
   168	public:
   169	    explicit PinnedHaloBuffers(const size_t plane_elements) {
   170	        const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
   171	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_lower_), bytes,
   172	                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
   173	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_upper_), bytes,
   174	                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
   175	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_lower_), bytes,
   176	                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
   177	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_upper_), bytes,
   178	                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
   179	    }
   180	
   180	
   181	    ~PinnedHaloBuffers() {
   182	        if (send_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_lower_);
   183	        if (send_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_upper_);
   184	        if (receive_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_lower_);
   185	        if (receive_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_upper_);
   186	    }
   187	
   188	    PinnedHaloBuffers(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
   189	    PinnedHaloBuffers& operator=(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
   190	
   191	    double* sendLower() const noexcept { return send_lower_; }
   192	    double* sendUpper() const noexcept { return send_upper_; }
   193	    double* receiveLower() const noexcept { return receive_lower_; }
   194	    double* receiveUpper() const noexcept { return receive_upper_; }
   195	
   196	private:
   197	    double* send_lower_ = nullptr;
   198	    double* send_upper_ = nullptr;
   199	    double* receive_lower_ = nullptr;
   200	    double* receive_upper_ = nullptr;
   201	};
   202	
   203	void exchangeHalos(double* const field, const size_t plane_elements,
   204	                   const size_t local_nz, const int rank, const int ranks,
   205	                   const int tag, const MPI_Comm communicator,
   206	                   PinnedHaloBuffers& halos, const cudaStream_t stream) {
   207	    const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
   208	    const bool has_lower_neighbor = rank > 0;
   209	    const bool has_upper_neighbor = rank + 1 < ranks;
   210	
   211	    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
   212	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendLower(), field + plane_elements,
   213	                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   214	    }
   215	    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
   216	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendUpper(),
   217	                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements,
   218	                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   219	    }
   220	    if (has_lower_neighbor || has_upper_neighbor) {
   221	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   222	    }
   223	
   224	    MPI_Request requests[4];
   225	    int request_count = 0;
   226	    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
   227	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
   228	                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
   229	                            &requests[request_count++]));
   230	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
   231	                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
   232	                            &requests[request_count++]));
   233	    }
   234	    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
   235	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
   236	                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
   237	                            &requests[request_count++]));
   238	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
   239	                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
   240	                            &requests[request_count++]));
   241	    }
   242	    if (request_count != 0) {
   243	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   244	    }
   245	
   246	    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
   247	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, halos.receiveLower(), bytes,
   248	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   249	    } else {
   250	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane_elements, bytes,
   251	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
   252	    }
   253	    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
   254	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
   255	                                   halos.receiveUpper(), bytes,
   256	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   257	    } else {
   258	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
   259	                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements, bytes,
   260	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
   261	    }
   262	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   263	}
   264	
   265	// Initialize only the owned portion of a slab.  The global linear index is
   266	// retained so MPI decomposition produces exactly the same initial field as
   267	// the original single-process implementation.
   268	void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
   269	                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
   270	                             const size_t local_nz, const size_t z_start,
   271	                             const size_t global_nz) {
   272	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
   273	    const size_t volume = plane * global_nz;
   274	
   275	    #pragma omp parallel for collapse(3) schedule(static)
   276	    for (std::ptrdiff_t z = 0; z < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(local_nz); ++z) {
   277	        for (std::ptrdiff_t y = 0; y < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(ny); ++y) {
   278	            for (std::ptrdiff_t x = 0; x < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(nx); ++x) {
   279	                const size_t local_index = idx3(static_cast<size_t>(x),
   280	                                                static_cast<size_t>(y),
   281	                                                static_cast<size_t>(z), nx, ny);
   282	                const size_t global_index =
   283	                    (z_start + static_cast<size_t>(z)) * plane +
   284	                    static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + static_cast<size_t>(x);
   285	                const double pseudo =
   286	                    ((((global_index + 1) * 1299709) % volume) /
   287	                     static_cast<double>(volume));
   288	                concentration[local_index] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
   289	            }
   290	        }
   291	    }
   292	}
   293	
   294	bool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& concentration) {
   295	    if (concentration.empty()) {
   296	        std::printf("Validation failed: empty concentration field\n");
   297	        return false;
   298	    }
   299	
   300	    double min_value = concentration[0];
   301	    double max_value = concentration[0];
   302	    int invalid = 0;
   303	
   304	    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(min:min_value) reduction(max:max_value) reduction(|:invalid) schedule(static)
   305	    for (std::ptrdiff_t i = 0;
   306	         i < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(concentration.size()); ++i) {
   307	        const double value = concentration[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
   308	        if (std::isnan(value) || std::isinf(value)) {
   309	            invalid = 1;
   310	        }
   311	        min_value = std::min(min_value, value);
   312	        max_value = std::max(max_value, value);
   313	    }
   314	
   315	    if (invalid != 0) {
   316	        std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   317	        return false;
   318	    }
   319	
   320	    std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", min_value, max_value);
   321	    if (max_value > 10.0 || min_value < -10.0) {
   322	        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   323	        return false;
   324	    }
   325	    return true;
   326	}
   327	
   328	int mpiCount(const size_t elements) {
   329	    if (elements > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
   330	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI slab exceeds the supported 32-bit MPI count\n");
   331	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
   332	    }
   333	    return static_cast<int>(elements);
   334	}
   335	
   336	void printUsage(const char* progName) {
   337	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
   338	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   339	    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\n");
   340	    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
   341	    std::printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
   342	    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\n");
   343	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   344	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   345	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   346	}
   347	
   348	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   349	    int mpi_thread_level = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   350	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &mpi_thread_level));
   351	    if (mpi_thread_level < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   352	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI implementation does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED\n");
   353	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
   354	    }
   355	
   356	    int world_rank = 0;
   357	    int world_size = 1;
   358	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
   359	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_size));
   360	
   360	
   361	    size_t nx = 64;
   362	    size_t ny = 0;
   363	    size_t nz = 0;
   364	    int iterations = 20;
   365	    bool validate = false;
   366	    bool printResults = false;
   367	
   368	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   369	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-x") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   370	            nx = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
   371	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-y") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   372	            ny = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
   373	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-z") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   374	            nz = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
   375	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   376	            iterations = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   377	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   378	            validate = true;
   379	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   380	            printResults = true;
   381	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   382	            if (world_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);
   383	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   384	            return 0;
   385	        } else {
   386	            if (world_rank == 0) {
   387	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   388	                printUsage(argv[0]);
   389	            }
   390	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   391	            return 1;
   392	        }
   393	    }
   394	
   395	    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;
   396	    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;
   397	
   398	    const size_t size_max = std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max();
   399	    const bool dimensions_valid =
   400	        nx != 0 && ny != 0 && nz != 0 && iterations >= 0 &&
   401	        nx <= size_max / ny && nx * ny <= size_max / nz &&
   402	        nx * ny <= static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX) &&
   403	        nx <= static_cast<size_t>(UINT_MAX) &&
   404	        ny <= static_cast<size_t>(UINT_MAX) &&
   405	        nz <= static_cast<size_t>(UINT_MAX);
   406	    if (!dimensions_valid) {
   407	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   408	            std::fprintf(stderr, "Invalid grid dimensions or iteration count\n");
   409	        }
   410	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   411	        return 1;
   412	    }
   413	
   414	    // Ranks beyond the number of Z planes remain idle, while active ranks
   415	    // retain a one-to-one, contiguous slab neighborhood.
   416	    const int active_ranks = static_cast<int>(std::min(nz, static_cast<size_t>(world_size)));
   417	    MPI_Comm active_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   418	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, world_rank < active_ranks ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED,
   419	                             world_rank, &active_communicator));
   420	
   421	    MPI_Comm shared_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   422	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, world_rank,
   423	                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &shared_communicator));
   424	
   425	    if (world_rank >= active_ranks) {
   426	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&shared_communicator));
   427	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   428	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   429	        return 0;
   430	    }
   431	
   432	    int rank = 0;
   433	    int ranks = 1;
   434	    int local_rank = 0;
   435	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(active_communicator, &rank));
   436	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(active_communicator, &ranks));
   437	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(shared_communicator, &local_rank));
   438	
   439	    int device_count = 0;
   440	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
   441	    if (device_count <= 0) {
   442	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA device\n", world_rank);
   443	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
   444	    }
   445	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count));
   446	    cudaDeviceProp device_properties{};
   447	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&device_properties, local_rank % device_count));
   448	    omp_set_dynamic(0);
   449	
   450	    const Slab slab = slabForRank(nz, rank, ranks);
   451	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
   452	    const size_t global_size = plane * nz;
   453	    const size_t local_size = plane * slab.nz;
   454	    const size_t device_size = plane * (slab.nz + 2);
   455	
   456	    if (rank == 0) {
   457	        std::printf("Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\n");
   458	        std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
   459	        std::printf("Time steps: %d\n", iterations);
   460	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   461	        std::printf("MPI ranks: %d\n", world_size);
   462	        std::printf("OpenMP threads/rank: %d\n", omp_get_max_threads());
   463	        std::printf("CUDA device: %s\n", device_properties.name);
   464	    }
   465	
   466	    std::vector<double> local_concentration(local_size);
   467	    std::printf("%s", rank == 0 ? "Initializing concentration field...\n" : "");
   468	    initializeConcentration(local_concentration, nx, ny, slab.nz, slab.z_start, nz);
   469	
   470	    DeviceAllocation concentration_old(device_size);
   471	    DeviceAllocation concentration_new(device_size);
   472	    DeviceAllocation chemical_potential(device_size);
   473	    PinnedHaloBuffers halo_buffers(plane);
   474	    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
   475	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   476	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(concentration_old.data() + plane,
   477	                               local_concentration.data(), local_size * sizeof(double),
   478	                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
   479	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   480	
   481	    const dim3 block(8, 8, 4);
   482	    const dim3 grid(
   483	        static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),
   484	        static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),
   485	        static_cast<unsigned int>((slab.nz + block.z - 1) / block.z));
   486	    const double dx = 1.0;
   487	    const double dy = 1.0;
   488	    const double dz = 1.0;
   489	    const double dt = 0.01;
   490	    const double e_AA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
   491	    const double e_BB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
   492	    const double e_AB = (2.0 / 9.0);
   493	    const double gamma = 0.5;
   494	    const double D = 1.0;
   495	    const double inv_dx2 = 1.0 / (dx * dx);
   496	    const double inv_dy2 = 1.0 / (dy * dy);
   497	    const double inv_dz2 = 1.0 / (dz * dz);
   498	
   499	    if (rank == 0) std::printf("Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\n");
   500	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(active_communicator));
   501	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   502	
   503	    double* current = concentration_old.data();
   504	    double* next = concentration_new.data();
   505	    if (iterations > 0) {
   506	        exchangeHalos(current, plane, slab.nz, rank, ranks, 100,
   507	                      active_communicator, halo_buffers, stream);
   508	    }
   509	
   510	    for (int t = 0; t < iterations; ++t) {
   511	        computeChemicalPotentialKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
   512	            current, chemical_potential.data(), nx, ny, slab.nz,
   513	            inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2, gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);
   514	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   515	        exchangeHalos(chemical_potential.data(), plane, slab.nz, rank, ranks, 200,
   516	                      active_communicator, halo_buffers, stream);
   517	
   518	        cahnHilliardUpdateKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
   519	            next, current, chemical_potential.data(), nx, ny, slab.nz,
   520	            inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2, D, dt);
   521	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   522	
   523	        std::swap(current, next);
   524	        if (t + 1 < iterations) {
   525	            exchangeHalos(current, plane, slab.nz, rank, ranks, 100,
   526	                          active_communicator, halo_buffers, stream);
   527	        }
   528	    }
   529	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   530	    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   531	    double maximum_elapsed = 0.0;
   532	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maximum_elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
   533	                         0, active_communicator));
   534	
   535	    if (rank == 0) {
   536	        const long long duration_ms = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(maximum_elapsed * 1000.0));
   537	        std::printf("Computation time: %lld ms\n", duration_ms);
   538	        const double cell_updates = static_cast<double>(global_size) * iterations;
   539	        const double seconds = std::max(maximum_elapsed, std::numeric_limits<double>::min());
   540	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n",
   541	                     cell_updates / seconds / 1e6);
   542	    }
   543	
   544	    int valid = 1;
   545	    if (printResults || validate) {
   546	        std::vector<double> local_result(local_size);
   547	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local_result.data(), current + plane,
   548	                              local_size * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   549	
   550	        std::vector<double> global_result;
   551	        std::vector<int> receive_counts;
   552	        std::vector<int> displacements;
   553	        if (rank == 0) {
   554	            global_result.resize(global_size);
   555	            receive_counts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ranks));
   556	            displacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ranks));
   557	            size_t displacement = 0;
   558	            for (int r = 0; r < ranks; ++r) {
   559	                const Slab other_slab = slabForRank(nz, r, ranks);
   560	                receive_counts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = mpiCount(plane * other_slab.nz);
   561	                displacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = mpiCount(displacement);
   562	                displacement += plane * other_slab.nz;
   563	            }
   564	        }
   565	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_result.data(), mpiCount(local_size), MPI_DOUBLE,
   566	                              rank == 0 ? global_result.data() : nullptr,
   567	                              rank == 0 ? receive_counts.data() : nullptr,
   568	                              rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
   569	                              MPI_DOUBLE, 0, active_communicator));
   570	
   571	        if (rank == 0) {
   572	            if (printResults) {
   573	                print_results(global_result, "Concentration");
   574	            }
   575	            if (validate) {
   576	                std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   577	                valid = validateResult(global_result) ? 1 : 0;
   578	                std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid != 0 ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   579	            }
   580	        }
   581	    }
   582	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, active_communicator));
   583	
   584	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
   585	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&shared_communicator));
   586	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&active_communicator));
   587	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   588	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   589	    return valid == 0 ? 1 : 0;
   590	}

+// ghost plane on either side, so both stencil applications are local after
+// the two neighboring planes have been exchanged.
+__host__ __device__ inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y,
+                                                 const size_t z, const size_t nx,
+                                                 const size_t ny) noexcept {
     return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;

+struct Slab {
+    size_t z_start;
+    size_t nz;
+};
+
+Slab slabForRank(const size_t global_nz, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = global_nz / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t remainder = global_nz % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t rank_as_size = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
+    return {
+        rank_as_size * base + std::min(rank_as_size, remainder),
+        base + (rank_as_size < remainder ? 1 : 0)
+    };

+[[noreturn]] void mpiFailure(const int error, const char* expression,
+                             const char* file, const int line) {
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int message_length = 0;

+__global__ void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+    double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
+    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
+    const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    // z=0 and z=local_nz+1 are the MPI ghost planes.
+    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
+    const double cv = concentration[index];
+    chemical_potential[index] =
+        4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) +
+        3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv -
+        gamma * deviceLaplacian(concentration, x, y, z, nx, ny,
+                                inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void cahnHilliardUpdateKernel(
+    double* __restrict__ concentration_new,
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration_old,
+    const double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
+    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
+    const double D, const double dt) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
+    concentration_new[index] = concentration_old[index] + dt * D *
+        deviceLaplacian(chemical_potential, x, y, z, nx, ny,
+                        inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);
 }

+class DeviceAllocation {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceAllocation(const size_t elements) {

+    }

     }

+class PinnedHaloBuffers {
+public:
+    explicit PinnedHaloBuffers(const size_t plane_elements) {
+        const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+    }
+
+    ~PinnedHaloBuffers() {
+        if (send_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_lower_);
+        if (send_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_upper_);
+        if (receive_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_lower_);
+        if (receive_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_upper_);
+    }
+
+    PinnedHaloBuffers(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+    PinnedHaloBuffers& operator=(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+
+    double* sendLower() const noexcept { return send_lower_; }
+    double* sendUpper() const noexcept { return send_upper_; }
+    double* receiveLower() const noexcept { return receive_lower_; }
+    double* receiveUpper() const noexcept { return receive_upper_; }
+
+private:
+    double* send_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* send_upper_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_upper_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+void exchangeHalos(double* const field, const size_t plane_elements,
+                   const size_t local_nz, const int rank, const int ranks,
+                   const int tag, const MPI_Comm communicator,
+                   PinnedHaloBuffers& halos, const cudaStream_t stream) {
+    const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+    const bool has_lower_neighbor = rank > 0;
+    const bool has_upper_neighbor = rank + 1 < ranks;
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendLower(), field + plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendUpper(),
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_lower_neighbor || has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    }
+
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+    int request_count = 0;
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (request_count != 0) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+    }
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, halos.receiveLower(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   halos.receiveUpper(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
 }

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                             const size_t local_nz, const size_t z_start,
+                             const size_t global_nz) {

+__global__ void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+    double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
+    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
+    const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    // z=0 and z=local_nz+1 are the MPI ghost planes.
+    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
+    const double cv = concentration[index];
+    chemical_potential[index] =
+        4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) +
+        3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv -
+        gamma * deviceLaplacian(concentration, x, y, z, nx, ny,
+                                inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);

+__global__ void cahnHilliardUpdateKernel(
+    double* __restrict__ concentration_new,
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration_old,
+    const double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
+    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
+    const double D, const double dt) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
+    concentration_new[index] = concentration_old[index] + dt * D *
+        deviceLaplacian(chemical_potential, x, y, z, nx, ny,
+                        inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);

+class DeviceAllocation {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceAllocation(const size_t elements) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), elements * sizeof(double)));
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceAllocation() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(data_);

     }
+
+    DeviceAllocation(const DeviceAllocation&) = delete;
+    DeviceAllocation& operator=(const DeviceAllocation&) = delete;
+
+    double* data() const noexcept { return data_; }
+
+private:
+    double* data_ = nullptr;

+class PinnedHaloBuffers {
+public:
+    explicit PinnedHaloBuffers(const size_t plane_elements) {
+        const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+    }
+
+    ~PinnedHaloBuffers() {
+        if (send_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_lower_);
+        if (send_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_upper_);
+        if (receive_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_lower_);
+        if (receive_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_upper_);
+    }
+
+    PinnedHaloBuffers(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+    PinnedHaloBuffers& operator=(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+
+    double* sendLower() const noexcept { return send_lower_; }
+    double* sendUpper() const noexcept { return send_upper_; }
+    double* receiveLower() const noexcept { return receive_lower_; }
+    double* receiveUpper() const noexcept { return receive_upper_; }
+
+private:
+    double* send_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* send_upper_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_upper_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+void exchangeHalos(double* const field, const size_t plane_elements,
+                   const size_t local_nz, const int rank, const int ranks,
+                   const int tag, const MPI_Comm communicator,
+                   PinnedHaloBuffers& halos, const cudaStream_t stream) {
+    const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+    const bool has_lower_neighbor = rank > 0;
+    const bool has_upper_neighbor = rank + 1 < ranks;
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendLower(), field + plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendUpper(),
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_lower_neighbor || has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    }
+
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+    int request_count = 0;
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (request_count != 0) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+    }
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, halos.receiveLower(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   halos.receiveUpper(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
 }

+// the original single-process implementation.
+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                             const size_t local_nz, const size_t z_start,
+                             const size_t global_nz) {

codex
Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA version.

- CUDA kernels perform both stencil phases.
- MPI decomposes Z slabs with halo exchange via pinned host buffers.
- OpenMP parallelizes initialization and validation.
- CMake requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA; executable remains `cahn_hilliard`.
- Default CUDA target is SM86, configurable via `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.

+// The global array is split into contiguous slabs in Z.  Each slab has one
+// ghost plane on either side, so both stencil applications are local after

+                                                 const size_t ny) noexcept {

+Slab slabForRank(const size_t global_nz, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = global_nz / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t remainder = global_nz % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t rank_as_size = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
+    return {
+        rank_as_size * base + std::min(rank_as_size, remainder),
+        base + (rank_as_size < remainder ? 1 : 0)
+    };
+}

+__global__ void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+    double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
+    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
+    const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    // z=0 and z=local_nz+1 are the MPI ghost planes.
+    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
+    const double cv = concentration[index];
+    chemical_potential[index] =
+        4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) +
+        3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv -
+        gamma * deviceLaplacian(concentration, x, y, z, nx, ny,
+                                inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);
+}
+
+__global__ void cahnHilliardUpdateKernel(
+    double* __restrict__ concentration_new,
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration_old,
+    const double* __restrict__ chemical_potential,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t local_nz,
+    const double inv_dx2, const double inv_dy2, const double inv_dz2,
+    const double D, const double dt) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t local_z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || local_z >= local_nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t z = local_z + 1;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
+    concentration_new[index] = concentration_old[index] + dt * D *
+        deviceLaplacian(chemical_potential, x, y, z, nx, ny,
+                        inv_dx2, inv_dy2, inv_dz2);
 }

+class PinnedHaloBuffers {
+public:
+    explicit PinnedHaloBuffers(const size_t plane_elements) {
+        const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_lower_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_upper_), bytes,
+                                 cudaHostAllocPortable));
+    }
+
+    ~PinnedHaloBuffers() {
+        if (send_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_lower_);
+        if (send_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_upper_);
+        if (receive_lower_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_lower_);
+        if (receive_upper_ != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_upper_);
+    }
+
+    PinnedHaloBuffers(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+    PinnedHaloBuffers& operator=(const PinnedHaloBuffers&) = delete;
+
+    double* sendLower() const noexcept { return send_lower_; }
+    double* sendUpper() const noexcept { return send_upper_; }
+    double* receiveLower() const noexcept { return receive_lower_; }
+    double* receiveUpper() const noexcept { return receive_upper_; }
+
+private:
+    double* send_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* send_upper_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_lower_ = nullptr;
+    double* receive_upper_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+void exchangeHalos(double* const field, const size_t plane_elements,
+                   const size_t local_nz, const int rank, const int ranks,
+                   const int tag, const MPI_Comm communicator,
+                   PinnedHaloBuffers& halos, const cudaStream_t stream) {
+    const size_t bytes = plane_elements * sizeof(double);
+    const bool has_lower_neighbor = rank > 0;
+    const bool has_upper_neighbor = rank + 1 < ranks;
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendLower(), field + plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(halos.sendUpper(),
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements,
+                                   bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_lower_neighbor || has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+    }
+
+    MPI_Request requests[4];
+    int request_count = 0;
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendLower(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(halos.receiveUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(halos.sendUpper(), static_cast<int>(plane_elements),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, tag, communicator,
+                            &requests[request_count++]));
+    }
+    if (request_count != 0) {
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+    }
+
+    if (has_lower_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, halos.receiveLower(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field, field + plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    if (has_upper_neighbor) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   halos.receiveUpper(), bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));
+    } else {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(field + (local_nz + 1) * plane_elements,
+                                   field + local_nz * plane_elements, bytes,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
 }

+// retained so MPI decomposition produces exactly the same initial field as
+// the original single-process implementation.
+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration,
+                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                             const size_t local_nz, const size_t z_start,
+                             const size_t global_nz) {
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const size_t volume = plane * global_nz;
+
+    #pragma omp parallel for collapse(3) schedule(static)
+    for (std::ptrdiff_t z = 0; z < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(local_nz); ++z) {
+        for (std::ptrdiff_t y = 0; y < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(ny); ++y) {
+            for (std::ptrdiff_t x = 0; x < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(nx); ++x) {

tokens used
147,640
Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA version.

- CUDA kernels perform both stencil phases.
- MPI decomposes Z slabs with halo exchange via pinned host buffers.
- OpenMP parallelizes initialization and validation.
- CMake requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA; executable remains `cahn_hilliard`.
- Default CUDA target is SM86, configurable via `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.
